model.name: Free-intercept log-linear (exponential) growth, censored MLE with 48-h periodic term
model.formula: log10 N(t) = a + b t + c cos(pi t) + d sin(pi t)
model.observation_model: Gaussian residuals on log10 density with constant sigma; the t=6 d non-detect enters as a left-censored (Tobit) contribution Phi((log10(10)-mu)/sigma).

diagnostics.baseline_comparison: Baseline log-linear: AICc=10.69, LOO log10-RMSE=0.259. 48-h periodic extension: AICc=9.70, LOO log10-RMSE=0.119. Selected: log-linear + 48h periodic; the extension was accepted only because it improved AICc and cut LOO log10-RMSE by >20%.
